verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a small set of first-party npm packages: the engine via `npm install playcanvas`, @playcanvas/react, web-components, PCUI, SplatTransform and the editor MCP server. superspl.at hosts published Gaussian splat scenes, but these are shareable scene pages, not a store of reusable game assets. There is no evidence of a large asset store or a third-party plugin and model marketplace. missing for 10: an asset store/marketplace for ready-made models and art, a third-party plugin ecosystem, evidence of ecosystem scale, independent corroboration of asset availability.
